# Barkly's

> Fear-Free home-based dog grooming, boarding, daycare, and dog sitting in Charlotte, NC. Serving Charlotte, South End, South Charlotte, Tega Cay SC, Fort Mill SC, Ballantyne NC, Matthews NC, Belmont NC, and Gastonia NC. A real home, not a chain salon or kennel — every appointment is paced to the dog, one-on-one.

## About

- Groomer: Vanessa Cordova, Fear Free Certified Professional. Veterinary education from Venezuela; currently continuing her veterinary education in the U.S. Five years of professional dog grooming experience; nearly two decades in animal care overall.
- Hours: Sunday 9am–5pm, Monday–Friday 6pm–9pm, Saturday 9am–5pm. By appointment only.

- Location: Home-based studio in Charlotte, NC. Exact address is shared after an appointment is confirmed — there is no public walk-in address.

## Services

- [Grooming](https://www.barklysclt.com/grooming): Full grooms, baths, and add-ons for all breeds, with extra experience with poodles, schnauzers, doodles, and small breeds. See [pricing](https://www.barklysclt.com/pricing.md).
- [Boarding, daycare & dog sitting](https://www.barklysclt.com/boarding): Overnight boarding and in-home dog sitting in a real home, not a kennel. Daytime daycare quoted per visit.
- [Book grooming online](https://www.barklysclt.com/book): Square Appointments booking widget. Boarding and daycare are requested by form and confirmed manually by phone or email.

## Policies

- Cancel at least 24 hours before your appointment and the deposit is refunded. Late arrivals, no-shows, and cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice forfeit the deposit.
- Grooming has a 15-minute grace period; after that the appointment is forfeited and the deposit is not refunded. Three no-shows and future appointments won't be booked.
- Pick up your dog within 30 minutes of being ready, or a boarding fee applies.
- Dogs must be 8 weeks or older with a current rabies vaccine (puppies 8 to 16 weeks are the exception), given at least 48 hours before service. DPP, Bordetella, and canine influenza are strongly recommended.
- Not accepted: pets in heat, with recent surgery, wearing an Elizabethan collar, with fleas or ticks, with a contagious illness now or in the past 30 days, or with unprovoked aggression that harmed a person or another pet. Full list on the policies page.
- Fear-Free handling: appointments are never rushed or forced. Breaks, extra time, or a follow-up visit are the plan, not an inconvenience.
